<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|420|THE EPISTLE OF S. PAVL|CHA. XV.}}</noinclude>Ghost. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=17}}† I haue therfore glorie in Christ {{sc|Iesvs}} tovvard God. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=18}}† For I dare not speake any of those things vvhich Christ vvorketh not by me for the obedience of the Gentils, by vvord and deedes, {{verse|chapter=15|verse=19}}† in the vertue of signes and wonders, in the vertue of the holy Ghost: so that from Hierusalem round about vnto Illyricum I haue replenished the Gospel of Christ. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=20}}† And I haue so preached this Gospel, not vvhere Christ vvas named, lest I should build vpon an other mans foundation: {{verse|chapter=15|verse=21}}† but as it is vvritten, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Esa. 52, 13.''}}* ''They to vvhom it hath not been preached of him, shal see: and they that haue not heard, shal vnderstand''. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=22}}† For the vvhich cause also I vvas hindred very much from comming vnto you. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=23}}† But now hauing no longer place in these countries, and hauing a desire to come vnto you these many yeres novv passed: {{verse|chapter=15|verse=24}}† vvhen I shal begin to take my iourney into Spaine, I hope that as I passe, I shal see you, and be brought thither of you, if first in part I shal haue enioyed you. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=25}}† Now therfore I vvil goe vnto Hierusalem to minister to the {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ He meaneth the holy persons that hauing forsaken al their goods for Christ, vvere vvholy conuerted to serue our Lord with al their minde. ''S. Hiero. against Vigilantius'' the Heretike reprehending the almes giuen to such, as do the Heretikes also of our time.}}∷ saincts. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=26}}† For Macedonia and Achaia haue liked vvel to make some contribution vpon the poore saincts that are in Hierusalem. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=27}}† For it hath pleased them: and they are their detters. For if the Gentiles be made partakers of their spiritual things: they ought also in carnal things to minister vnto them. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=28}}† This therfore vvhen I shal haue accomplished, and signed them this fruite, I vvil goe by you into Spaine. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=29}}† And I knovv that comming to you, I shal come in aboundance of the blessing of Christ. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=30}}† I beseeche you therfore brethren by our Lord {{sc|Iesvs}} Christ, and by the charitie of the holy Ghost, that you {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ In that the Apostle desired to be praied for, vve may be moued to seeke the same as a great benefite.}}∷ helpe me in your praiers for me to God, {{verse|chapter=15|verse=31}}† that I may be deliuered from the infidels that are in Ievvrie, and the oblation of my seruice may become acceptable in Hierusalem to the saincts, {{verse|chapter=15|verse=32}}† that I may come to you in ioy by the vvil of God, that I may be refreshed vvith you. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=33}}† And the God of peace be vvith you all. Amen.

{{c|{{larger|{{sc|Chap. XVI.}}}}}}

{{c|''He commendeth the bearer Phœbè to the Romanes, 3 and him self to many there by name. 17 he declareth the doctrine vvhich the Romanes had learned, to be the touchstone to know Seducers. 21 he doth vnto them the commendations of al the Churches and of certaine persons by name: 25 and concludeth.''}}<noinclude>{{rh|||AND}}</noinclude>
